people.name: Agag
people.line: Amalekite king captured and killed by Samuel

people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

translations.web: He took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.
translations.bsb: He captured Agag king of Amalek alive, but devoted all the others to destruction with the sword.
translations.kjv: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.
